title: Product Update - November
summary: Custom footers, plus the Render API, Loops for Attio and refreshed templates
body_markdown:
The bottom of every email you send is finally yours to design. Custom footers are live.


We also shipped the Render API, an official Attio app, and a refresh of every template in the app.


## Release: Custom footers


We added custom footer support. To get set up, head to **Settings** , then **Footers** , and build a footer with the same editor and styling controls as your emails.


You can rewrite the default copy, add your logo and links, and place it inside or below your email content. You can switch between different footers, set a new default or just keep our default footer.


While editing the footer, you can also preview your footer alongside real emails before you publish, then make it your team default for new emails only, or for your existing emails too.


And we still have your back on compliance. **Guardian** makes sure every footer includes your company name, address and unsubscribe link before it goes live.


Footers are in the API too, so your agent can create, edit and publish footers, set the default, and pick a footer for each email.


[Design your footer](https://loops.so/docs/creating-emails/footers)


## Release: Render API


You can now render any campaign, workflow or transactional email to HTML through the API, exactly the way its preview email renders. This is helpful for rapid iterations with an agent locally if you'd prefer to work with Loops without opening Loops.


Pass in contact properties, event properties or data variables and you get back the finished email!


Use it to show previews inside your own app, run visual checks in CI, or let your agent check its work before anything goes out. It's also in the CLI as of v0.14.0.


Try asking your agent:


> Render my welcome workflow emails in Loops for a free user and a paid user. Flag anything that looks broken, empty or off-brand, then suggest fixes.


[Read the Render API docs](https://loops.so/docs/api-reference/render-email-message)


## Integration: Loops for Attio


The official Loops app is now live in the Attio marketplace. Sync people from Attio into Loops one at a time, in bulk from a list, or automatically from an Attio workflow.


It also works the other direction! Trigger Loops workflows from Attio events, and update Attio when something happens in Loops.


[Setup Attio with Loops](https://attio.com/apps/loops-so)


## Improvement: Refreshed email templates


Every email template in the app has been refreshed. If you haven't started from a template in a while, take another look next time you create a campaign, workflow or transactional email.


## Video: Black Friday dos and don'ts


Black Friday and Cyber Monday are almost here. Ian put together a quick video on what to do, and what to skip, before your BFCM emails go out.


## Misc: Everything else


-


Your sending status now shows in the sidebar, and the editor tells you what's left before your team can send. Still setting up your domain? Copy a prompt from Setup options and hand your DNS records to your agent.


-


Scheduled campaigns now show their send time in the campaign list.


-


When you bulk add contacts to a list, choose whether it triggers workflows and see which ones would run.


-


Collapsed groups in list views now stay collapsed and sync across tabs. Alt+click opens or closes every group at once.


-


Keep editing workflows while changes save. Rapid edits are no longer lost between saves.


-


CSV imports are faster and catch problems in the upload form before you import. They also show whether they're queued or importing, and how many rows are done.


-


Change a goal's default attribution window after tracking has started.


-


Use a variable for an email's reply-to address through the API.


-


Move workflows between groups through the API with workflowGroupId, and filter campaigns, workflows and transactional emails by group.


-


The JavaScript, PHP and Ruby SDKs and the CLI (v0.14.0) are updated for the latest API.


-


Plus dozens of fixes across the editor, audience filters, domain verification and CC/BCC delivery.


## Customers: New customer stories


Ian, our Product Educator, has been busy! Three new stories are up:


-


[Slite](https://loops.so/customers/slite) turns ebook downloads into returning readers with a single workflow.


-


[Runable](https://loops.so/customers/runable) emails 1.7 million users with Loops.


-


[Trails](https://loops.so/customers/trails) keeps email simple for a founder who is also the marketer.


[Read all customer stories](https://loops.so/customers)
